about: module simd's mutants (U1 SIMD-SCAN); each is judged by the module's laws (examples:modules/simd). The kernels run only in a vector build, so env sets GOEXPERIMENT=simd for every run of this ledger's suite; the stock build runs the Ergo reference, which the same laws hold by the module's tests without it. The law that kills each is named in its rule.

mutants.name: simd-tail-dropped
mutants.rule: The scalar tail after the last whole vector is scanned: scan.IndexByteIsTheReference (needle after 0 to 127 filler bytes).

mutants.name: simd-mask-order-reversed

mutants.to:

mutants.rule: Mask bit k is byte k, so the first match is the lowest bit: scan.IndexByteIsTheReference.

mutants.name: simd-any2-second-dropped
mutants.rule: Either needle ends the scan: scan.IndexAny2IsTheReference.

mutants.name: simd-outside-hi-dropped
mutants.rule: A byte above hi is outside: scan.IndexOutsideIsTheReference.

mutants.name: simd-count-tail-dropped
mutants.rule: The tail's bytes are counted: scan.CountByteIsTheReference.
